units.graded_states: 24 per study: 6 initial drafts (I) and 18 finals (A, B, C). Every planned state is graded, including timed-out, partial or unchanged ones.
units.claims: Descriptive per-task outcomes only. No significance test, effect size or general quality, speed or cost claim.

evidence_order: 1. Build and common acceptance: fmt, clippy -D warnings, full cargo test, scope/dependency audit (lead, deterministic).
2. Hidden checks: private grader at the committed SHA-256, one fresh fixture root per state (deterministic, primary).
3. Blind grader review: anonymous diffs, source tree and steps 1-2 outputs (secondary; findings need corroboration).
4. Finding reconciliation: map every reviewer or self-check finding to evidence (non-blind, separate step).

fatal.definition: The state does not compile, or no usable binary can be produced from it.
fatal.counting: One fatal flag per state, ranked with blockers. Hidden checks are then not_run and are NOT counted as separate defects.

severity.blocker: A stated safety invariant is violated: protected, active, unverified or retention-protected history deleted; a dry run or invalid input deletes; a read-only path writes, renews or signals; symlink refusal bypassed; environment values exposed; a mismatched keyed retry reused; or the requested feature is absent or unusable.
severity.major: A stated acceptance criterion fails in an ordinary scenario: wrong selection, window, order, count or path; an unchanged-behavior regression; an invalid value accepted with wrong behavior; full cargo test fails; required tests missing for a whole criterion.
severity.minor: An edge-case, message, envelope, help or README deviation; fmt or clippy failure; weak but present tests; nonzero required but a different nonzero class returned.

defect_record.reproduction: A command sequence with fixture or a cited code path plus the input that reaches it. A model opinion without one is recorded as unconfirmed and never counted.

causal_dedup: Hidden-check severities are frozen in the grader declaration. Each failing causal group counts as one defect at the highest severity among its non-dependent failing checks.
A failing check whose declared depends_on check also failed is a dependent symptom and does not count.
Groups sharing one root cause are merged into one defect when the blind grader cites the single code location responsible; the merged defect takes the highest severity.
If the feature is absent or unusable, every positive check failure collapses into one blocker. Safety and compatibility checks still count separately when they fail.
One unique_issue_id is kept for the same causal issue across I, A, B and C on a task, so corrections and regressions can be tracked.

issue_transitions.validated_correction: A unique issue present and confirmed in I and absent in the final state, confirmed by the same check or reproduction.
issue_transitions.introduced_regression: A unique issue absent in I and confirmed in the final state.
issue_transitions.persisting: Confirmed in both I and the final state.
issue_transitions.count_rule: Report counts per task and branch by severity; never net corrections against regressions inside a single number.

blind_grader.model: claude-fable-5-1, high reasoning, fresh call per state or per anonymised batch
sees: read access to the state's source tree
never_sees: which state is the initial draft
blind_grader.identical_trees: States with identical tree hashes are graded once under one label and the result is copied to each; the mapping is held by the lead.
tasks: confirm or merge hidden-check defects by root cause
report further defects with reproduction or conclusive code analysis tied to the criterion, including an executable failure scenario

maintainability_0_4.0: Unmaintainable: logic conflicts with existing structure, misleading names or comments, dead or duplicated code paths that will diverge.
maintainability_0_4.1: Poor: works locally but is placed or duplicated inconsistently with existing helpers; tests brittle (timing, live processes) or missing.
maintainability_0_4.2: Adequate: follows the existing structure with some duplication, unclear edges or thin tests or docs.
maintainability_0_4.3: Good: idiomatic and localized, reuses existing helpers, deterministic tests cover the criteria, docs accurate.
maintainability_0_4.4: Excellent: minimal and clear, well-factored, precise deterministic tests, exact docs, nothing superfluous.

finding_reconciliation.applies_to: Every finding produced by the A self-check, the B review and the C review.

classes.true_positive: Matches a defect confirmed in I by a hidden check, common acceptance or a reproduction.
classes.false_positive: The specific alleged failure is contradicted by a reproduction that exercises it or by conclusive code analysis against the written criterion. A different passing check or lack of reproduction does not disprove a finding.
classes.unconfirmed: Neither confirmed nor contradicted with the available evidence. Never counted as true or false.

also_report: true positives the revision fixed, left unfixed or fixed with a regression
blind grader defects in I that no review or self-check reported (unique catches)
findings outside the stated requirements (scope suggestions), listed separately

comparison.task_score: Lexicographic tuple (fatal + blocker count, major count, minor count) over unique counted defects in the final state. Lower is better.
comparison.task_win: X wins task t against Y when score(X_t) < score(Y_t). Equal tuples are a tie.
comparison.maintainability: Reported per state and used only to order tied tasks in the descriptive table. A maintainability-only difference is never a win and never a defect benefit.

pairs.C_vs_B: skill-specific effect: agents-collab-led against manual independent review with the same models

quality_advantage_established_only_if_al: the first-named branch wins at least 2 of 6 tasks
its task wins outnumber its task losses
at least one win includes a validated correction of a major or blocker issue that the other branch's final state still has
it introduces no new blocker in any final state (no blocker introduced_regression)
its summed major count over the six finals does not exceed the other branch's
every planned state of both branches is complete and gradable

otherwise.too_few_initial_defects: If fewer than 2 initial drafts contain a confirmed major or blocker defect, report 'no quality advantage established (inconclusive: too few initial defects)'.
otherwise.criteria_not_met: Report 'no quality advantage established'. Never report equivalence or harm-free parity.
otherwise.incomplete: If a required model, control or access is unavailable, or a planned state cannot be fully graded, report 'incomplete/inconclusive' for every comparison involving it. Never drop the state, substitute a model or record zero usage.

per_branch: provider-reported tokens or usage (known, partial or unknown)
secondary_measures.rule: Unknown usage is unknown, never zero. Secondary measures never offset a quality result.

record_per_state: writes outside case, records, build or fixture locations where observable
processes left running after the state's tests
scope_safety.severity: An out-of-scope source change is minor unless it alters behavior outside the ticket (major) or touches skill, website, release or packaging files (blocker for scope).

reporting: per-task table: I, A, B, C scores, maintainability and transitions
exact hidden check outcomes per state
grader or harness defects found after freeze, with the original outputs kept
